Players Committee card image of [[Admiral Trench]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Unless alone, may place Trench in Used Pile to make an [Episode I] starship here immune to attrition for remainder of turn. While at opponent's system, their starships deploy +1 here.” Uploaded unchanged.
